items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Professor Willis James came up there from Spelman, and he gave a lecture on the origin of that music, which was so enlightening to me.

ctx.x: Lenox, Massachusetts had the music barn. And Professor Willis James came up there from Spelman, and he gave a lecture on the origin of that music, which was so enlightening to me. I had never thought of it as being a development from salve hollers in the field. And he demonstrated how expressive so-and-so would be when his day was done, and this field holler that he would emit meant that he was through with that long day in the fields and was going home. And he was identified through his holler that he gave at…
And the Latin thing too, right? From Cuba?
